MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash

   D. Ice melting to water
